summary: Smart Powerr Corp. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered direct offering of 4,500,000 shares of common stock at $0.45 per share, with an option for purchasers to buy an additional 4,500,000 shares within 30 days. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Terms include a market price of $0.6224 per share on May 18, 2026. Univest Securities is the placement agent, not an underwriter. The offering complies with Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6, limited to one-third of public float. This is a standard equity financing for a Nevada holding company with PRC operations; no event-driven elements such as a takeover, restructuring, or activist campaign are present.
